solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Elusive thing, article in tree I spy endlessly

indicators.note: the article is placed in the middle of the tree's name, splitting it open

parts.note: a willow is a tree
the definite article is 'the'

indicators.note: the word spy loses its final letter, having no end

explanation.surface: A child playing I spy in the woods, glimpsing something hidden in a tree that keeps slipping away.
explanation.definitionFit: Folklore's flickering marsh light that leads travellers astray gives its name to any hope or goal that can never be caught.

clue.text: Leading group of students against the flow

parts.note: a team that is ahead is up
a stream is a class of pupils grouped by ability in British schools

explanation.surface: The top class of students is going against the prevailing current.
explanation.walkthrough: In British schools pupils are often 'streamed', put in a stream or set by ability.
explanation.definitionFit: Travelling toward a river's source means moving opposite to its current.

clue.text: Speak disparagingly of drinking noisily? Not half!

indicators.note: only half of the word is kept, the first four of its eight letters

parts.note: slurping is drinking with loud sucking noises

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to criticise a noisy drinker, and the reply is the British exclamation 'not half!', meaning 'absolutely'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half!' is British slang for 'very much so', but here it tells you to keep only half of SLURPING.
explanation.definitionFit: To slur someone is to insult or cast aspersions on them, a synonym for disparaging.

clue.text: Fisherman in corner on right

parts.note: a corner is where two lines meet at an angle

explanation.surface: A fisherman is sitting in the corner of a riverbank, off to the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fishes with a rod and line is called by this synonym.

clue.text: Offer support also, when confused

parts.note: a prop is something that holds up or supports

indicators.note: the letters of 'also' are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone muddled offers backing as well.
explanation.definitionFit: An offer put forward for consideration, such as a plan or marriage bid, is a synonym.

clue.text: Beautiful blonde

definitions.meaning: an old poetic sense, as in '... maiden', meaning lovely
light-coloured hair is described with this adjective

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: archaic for lovely, and pale in hair or complexion.

clue.text: One politician the Spanish push forward

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one
a Member of Parliament
el is the Spanish masculine definite article

explanation.surface: A lone MP and a Spanish group are urging some cause onward.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive or propel something onward is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Joy driving vehicle through pouring rain

indicators.note: the vehicle passes through the middle of the scrambled weather word
pouring suggests the letters of rain tumbling into a new order

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone finds bliss steering a van through a downpour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joy' at the front is the definition; 'pouring' rearranges the weather word to NIRA, which 'through' then splits open around the vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: The Buddhist state of perfect peace is used loosely for bliss or great happiness.

clue.text: Runner's complaint? Trainer will cover it

definitions.text: Runner's complaint? Trainer will cover it

parts.words: Runner's complaint? Trainer will cover it
parts.note: a sports shoe or trainer covers the foot of a runner, whose fungal ailment is named after sportsmen

explanation.surface: A runner grumbles, and the coach promises to handle the issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trainer' looks like a coach, but it is a running shoe, which covers the affected part.
explanation.definitionFit: This fungal skin infection between the toes is named after sportspeople, a runner's ailment in a literal sense.

clue.text: Subsequently meets a learner on the side

parts.note: subsequently means later
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Later on, a learner driver is met at the roadside.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral describes something relating to or situated at the flank, a synonym for sideways.

clue.text: Resting place by church

parts.note: per means by, as in 'per post'

explanation.surface: A bird settles down for a rest near the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A bar or branch where a bird roosts is its spot for sitting.

clue.text: He's enthralled by sign in book

indicators.note: being held captive by something means sitting inside it

parts.note: Taurus is a sign of the zodiac
taken as written, with the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A man is captivated by a horoscope he has read.
explanation.definitionFit: A reference work listing synonyms, such as Roget's, is a particular book.

clue.text: Great food, as IOM bar prepared

indicators.note: food that is prepared has been made ready, suggesting the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A bar on the Isle of Man serves excellent fare.
explanation.walkthrough: IOM is the Isle of Man, a self-governing island in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the food of the gods, used for any delicious dish.

clue.text: Signal for action in botanical gardens heard

indicators.note: what is listened to rather than seen, so the gardens' name is said aloud

parts.note: Kew Gardens in London houses the Royal Botanic Gardens

explanation.surface: A signal to start something is overheard at a garden.
explanation.walkthrough: KEW is the Royal Botanic Gardens in south-west London.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor's prompt to come in or speak is the classic theatrical signal.

clue.text: Girl left in vehicle is as upset

indicators.note: the letter for left sits inside the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the two letters of 'as' are read upwards

explanation.surface: A girl abandoned in a car is distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, famous from Richardson's novel, stands for a girl.

clue.text: Some squirrel monkeys in wood

indicators.note: only part of the phrase is taken, a run of its letters

explanation.surface: A few squirrel monkeys live in the forest.
explanation.definitionFit: Elm is a hardwood timber as well as the tree it comes from.

clue.text: Domineering woman to fight the sack?

parts.note: a battle is a fight
getting the axe means being dismissed or sacked

explanation.surface: A bossy woman fights against being fired.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal term for an aggressive, overbearing older woman.

clue.text: Harden mood

definitions.meaning: to toughen steel or glass by heating and cooling

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: toughening metal, and a person's disposition.

clue.text: Go with oil, for a change, in house

indicators.note: change suggests the letters are moved into a different order

explanation.surface: An advert urges switching to oil heating at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A dome-shaped Inuit dwelling of snow blocks is a kind of house.

clue.text: Register is kept by lieutenant

indicators.note: something kept by another is held within it

explanation.surface: An officer keeps the roll of names.
explanation.definitionFit: A register is a written record of names, a synonym for a roll or catalogue.

clue.text: Old woman with difficult dog

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother, one's 'old woman'
a stiff test is a difficult one

explanation.surface: An elderly lady owns an awkward hound.
explanation.definitionFit: A mastiff is a large, powerful breed, an example of a dog.

clue.text: Wise man employed by news agency

indicators.note: the letters are held within the phrase, as a worker is within a firm

explanation.surface: A clever man works for a press agency.
explanation.definitionFit: A sage is a person of great wisdom, a synonym for a wise man.

clue.text: Hobby in old man's era

parts.note: pa is a word for father, the 'old man', so belonging to him is pa's
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A hobby that was popular in Dad's day.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastime is an activity done for pleasure, a synonym for a hobby.

clue.text: Gadget made by US soldiers and army medic

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
MO is a medical officer in the army

explanation.surface: American troops and a military doctor rig up a contraption.
explanation.definitionFit: Gismo is informal for a clever device or gizmo whose name one does not know.
